about.headline: You keep the house running. We keep the roof over it.
about.body: When something's wrong with a roof, homeowners want the same things: someone who picks up the phone, a straight answer about what needs fixing, and a price in writing before any shingles come off. Every job is handled around that, from the first look to the last nail swept up.

cards.title: Roofs that are done

cards.title: Leaks and small repairs
cards.body: Shingle, flashing, fascia and soffit repairs handled properly, without turning a small job into a big one.

about.closing: Not sure how bad it is? Send a few photos and we'll tell you straight.

realReviews.author: Rachel Sheets
realReviews.text: This company was the most honest and standup people we've ever come across. We had several companies approach us about redoing our roof. Most of them were extremely pushy and to be honest unprofessional. James came out and helped us understand the whole process and answered all our questions. Angie was amazing to work with. Helped me understand the whole process and dealing with insurance companies. You don't find this kind of honesty and professionalism anymore. Thank you for making this process stress free as possible. We will definitely be using this company for future projects!!!

realReviews.author: Ting Kellerman
realReviews.text: Our roof took on some damage from the recent wind storm. Bigs/James was very responsive and got our roof repaired quickly. He had someone out the same day to do an assessment and repair was complete the next day. I’m very thankful for the quick turnaround as the missing shingles were causing me to panic on any unforeseen issues if left unresolved.  Before and after pictures attached. Highly recommend Bigs for your roofing needs.

realReviews.author: Angela S
realReviews.text: Due to the high winds, some of my fascia fell off the roof and I was about to lose the soffit.  My neighbor called about her roof shingles and told them about my roof issue too. They called back within the hour on a Sunday! They arrived a few hours later and fixed the issues on the spot! Thank you so much!

finalCta.headline: Got a leak, storm damage or an old roof?
finalCta.body: Send your address and a few photos or pick a time for an inspection. You'll get a written estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight answer about your roof.

faq.a: Send your address and a few photos through the form or give us a call. We'll inspect the roof and send a written estimate that lists the scope and price.

faq.q: Can you help with an insurance claim for storm or hail damage?
faq.a: We'll inspect the damage, document it and walk you through how the process works, so you know what to expect when you deal with your insurance company.

faq.q: Do I need a repair or a full replacement?
faq.a: It depends on the age of the roof and how widespread the damage is. We'll tell you what we see and give you the options that make sense, not just the biggest job.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book an inspection.
